finding: Canonical attention source column counts grow with O=0/150/300, but the trace validator required complete source descriptors to be identical across contexts and would reject a valid real trace at O=150.
resolution: The wrapper now obtains the strictly validated canonical oracle plan and the trace validator compares each context metadata block exactly with its corresponding plan. Cross-context identity checks retain stable IDs, names, rows and codecs while allowing plan-bound columns.

checks.command: C71_CALIBRATION_BINARY=$PWD/rust/target/debug/examples/c71_calibration PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=$PWD/scripts .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_c71_calibration.py tests/test_c71_calibration_trace.py

regression: A framed three-context fixture with changing source columns passes only against the matching oracle plan; a one-column plan mutation is rejected.
